item.title: Before They JUMP SHIP
item.description: An Amazing Fact: In November 2022, 28-year-old James Grimes fell from a cruise ship into the dark waters of the Gulf of Mexico. With no life jacket, he treaded water for nearly 20 hours—battling exhaustion, cold currents, and fear—before being rescued. “It was just the Lord out there giving me the strength to stay afloat,” […]

item.title: Clothed by Christ: Dressing for Success
item.description: What kind of clothing will matter most when Jesus comes? And are you dressed for eternity? Join Pastor Doug Batchelor as he opens Scripture to reveal the meaning of the wedding garment, the armor of God, and the spotless robe of Christ’s righteousness in these last days.

item.title: From Lost to Found
item.description: God is moving mightily across Africa—and 2025 has been a year of extraordinary spiritual harvest. Thanks to your faithful prayers and generous giving, villages, towns, and cities throughout Uganda, Kenya, and South Sudan have had the opportunity to hear the everlasting gospel, and thousands are turning to Jesus! item.title: War With Iran and Armageddon
item.description: The United States and Israel attacked Iran in a bid to eliminate its nuclear program and push regime change. The countries continue to exchange blows as the conflict escalates and spreads across the Middle East. Though the potential outcome is concerning, the Bible warns that it pales in significance to what’s coming: the Battle of Armageddon.

item.title: SEND ME: The 2026 AFY Conference Begins June 17!
item.description: Amazing Facts International’s sixth annual youth conference, “SEND ME: Here I Am, Lord,” will give young people the opportunity to experience spiritual renewal and discover what it means to answer God’s call in a world full of distractions.

item.title: Pastor Doug Batchelor to Speak in Nairobi for Streams of Light Revival Meetings
item.description: Pastor Doug Batchelor, president of Amazing Facts International, will travel to Nairobi, Kenya, March 25–28, 2026, for Streams of Light: Revived for Mission—a special week of Bible-centered messages presented in partnership with the East Nairobi Field of Seventh-day Adventists.

item.title: Back to the Garden: An Edenic Approach to Colorectal Cancer Prevention
item.description: Colorectal cancer rates are surging in adults under 50, and modern diets are a driving force. From Eden to Daniel in Babylon, Scripture has always guided us toward better dietary choices. What’s on your plate?

item.title: A Providential Moment to Share Revelation 14!
item.description: As America celebrates its 250th anniversary, a massive gathering of Christians at the National Mall in Washington, D.C., presents a unique opportunity for Sabbath-keepers to share the three angels’ messages with sincere believers seeking revival.
